observations.default_disabled: Without both server-side variables, no admin request occurs and the two reserved routes return an explicit disabled 404 while unrelated single-account behavior remains usable.
observations.sanitized_boundary: Status and router.switch events are independently revalidated and copied through exact browser-facing field whitelists.

observations.upstream_mergeability: The adapter is a small overlay pinned by codex-web revision and source digest; tests changed only a temporary copy and the upstream tracked diff stayed clean.

residual_risks: A future codex-web source revision requires explicit overlay review and a new pinned digest.
JavaScript bearer-token strings cannot be forcibly zeroed, although their lifetime and use are confined to the server-side authorization callback.
M4.3 must add the UI without expanding the sanitized bridge contract.
M0.3, M3.5, and M4.1 approved account-switch rows remain unrun and mandatory; M4.2 is not continuity evidence.
